result.stdout:
radivum-oss — collect and report Azure network inventory using your own identity.

Usage:
  radivum-oss login-status
      Shows subscriptions visible to the current login.

  radivum-oss collect --scope <scope> [--out <dir>] [--resolve-links <true|false>]
      Collects Azure network inventory and writes network-snapshot.json, findings.json,
      network-report.md, network-graph.json, network-topology.md, and analysis-manifest.json.
      <scope>: subscription id, /subscriptions/<id>, or /subscriptions/<id>/resourceGroups/<rg>
      --scope: may be repeated to collect up to 3 subscriptions of one tenant.
               A resource group scope takes exactly one subscription.
      --out:   output directory (default: ./output)
      --resolve-links: look up the resources a NIC or private endpoint belongs to (default: false).
                       One extra read; targets outside the collected subscriptions stay named from their id.

  radivum-oss report --snapshot <file> [--out <dir>]
      Loads an existing network-snapshot.json and regenerates its report, graph, and topology.

  radivum-oss graph --snapshot <file> [--out <dir-or-file>]
      Builds a deterministic network-graph.json from a saved network-snapshot.json.
      An export step: collect and report already write this artifact.
      --out: output directory (network-graph.json) or explicit .json file path.

  radivum-oss diagram --snapshot <file> [--out <dir-or-file>] [--format mermaid]
      Builds a deterministic Mermaid topology from a saved network-snapshot.json.
      An export step: collect and report already write network-topology.md.
      --format: currently supports only 'mermaid'.
      --out: output directory (network-topology.md) or explicit .md file path.

Requirements:
  az CLI installed and logged in (az login).
